basic_details.job_title: HLL Operations Manager (Biomedical) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, is filling 1 Operations Manager (Biomedical) post in its HCD (Projects & Services – Division) on an Executive – Fixed Term Contract, with a basic pay range of Rs. 30000 – 50000 per month and posting in Rajasthan. The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech or M.Sc in the listed Biomedical and electronics disciplines, or a Diploma, with 6 or 10 years of post-qualification experience respectively. Applications go through a Google Form from 3 November 2026 to 18 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 45 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice says the date for determining the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not print the number of years.

qualification.details: BE / B.Tech (Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electronics & Communication / Medical Electronics) or M.Sc (Biomedical Instrumentation). OR Diploma in Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / other equivalent qualification as per requirement.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form through the application link given in the notice.
Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website.
Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted.
Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file.
Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required, each under 10 MB.
Select the correct post applied for in the form.
Submit the form on or before 18 November 2026. Late submissions will not be considered.
The job title and reference code (HLL/HR/104/2026) must be clearly mentioned in the application form.
Completed prescribed application form (PDF or Word).
CV, educational/experience certificates and latest salary slip, if required.
SC/ST candidates: SC/ST Caste Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India.
OBC candidates: Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India.
Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies: No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be considered for the selection process, and no further communication will be sent separately. Candidates should make sure they fulfil all the eligibility criteria before applying. HLL may increase or decrease the number of vacancies based on organizational requirements. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: About HLL Lifecare Limited
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. According to the notice, it commenced operations on 5 April 1969 and now works across healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy, hospital management and other allied services. The notice puts the HLL Group's annual business turnover at approximately ₹6,500 crore.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: BE / B.Tech (Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electronics & Communication / Medical Electronics) or M.Sc (Biomedical Instrumentation). OR Diploma in Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / other equivalent qualification as per requirement. BE / B.Tech / M.Sc holders: minimum 6 years of post-qualification experience in managing assigned projects from planning and tendering through installation and handover, ensuring timely delivery, procurement compliance, ensuring quality and effective supervision. Diploma holders: minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in the same kind of work. The maximum age is 45 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice says the date for determining the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not print the number of years. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Strong MS Office and presentation skills are mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is an Executive – Fixed Term Contract. The notice does not state the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: HLL Operations Manager (Biomedical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Plan site surveys and coordinate with institute committees, consultants, OEMs and hospital authorities. Finalise technical specifications, layouts and BOQs in consultation with end users. Coordinate with the tender team for tender preparation, representation, clarification of technical shortfalls, product demonstrations and obtaining client approval of estimated costs. Ensure compliance with GFR, GeM, Make in India, MSE procurement policy and local-content requirements. Manage suppliers, delivery schedules, EMD, performance security, BG validity, LD and contract changes within delegated powers. Supervise installation, testing and commissioning; lead acceptance checks and project handover. Verify and recommend vendor bills in accordance with contract terms and applicable deductions. Maintain audit-ready records and submit regular project progress, cost and risk reports to management. Monitor warranty and CAMC activities and ensure proper handover of service. Supervise, guide and monitor the performance of Biomedical Engineers and site-level teams, ensuring effective coordination, smooth project execution and timely completion of assigned activities. Perform any other duties assigned by management from time to time.

content_sections.text: Open the Google Form through the application link given in the notice. Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website. Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted. Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file. Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required, each under 10 MB. Select the correct post applied for in the form. Submit the form on or before 18 November 2026. Late submissions will not be considered. The job title and reference code (HLL/HR/104/2026) must be clearly mentioned in the application form. Completed prescribed application form (PDF or Word). CV, educational/experience certificates and latest salary slip, if required. SC/ST candidates: SC/ST Caste Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India. OBC candidates: Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in the format applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India. Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies: No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice mentions an interview, at which all information in the application will be verified with original documents. If any information is found false, incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process, or to not fill any or all of the posts. The decision of Management regarding selection is final.
